# Town of Shoreham municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Shoreham, Auditors page (live, headed 'Elected Auditors'): the three current auditors are Tamra Hawley-House, Karen Jarboe-Singletary, and Michelle Treadway. Mapping adjudication (disclosed on issue #163): Hawley-House and Jarboe-Singletary are recorded elected on the page's presentation -- they fill the second open seat and the seat of Maureen Gour, who no longer appears on the page (her membership is ended in this sweep; no election or appointment record for either woman appears in the selectboard minutes January-September 2026).
Town of Shoreham, Selectboard minutes, March 11, 2026 (repeated March 25, 2026): on motion, Michelle Treadway was appointed to fill a vacant auditor seat for 2026 until the March 2027 elections.

Town of Shoreham, Planning Commission page (live): the commission's seven current members include Heather Stafford, Linda Larrabee, and Kevin Fox alongside the four already recorded. The commission is elected; no per-person terms are published.
